nom: MAC Mini Hyper Real Fresh Canvas Cream-To-Foam Face Cleanser

avis.texte: This cleanser has become a staple in my nightly makeup removal routine. I originally purchased it in January and just picked up a new bottle yesterday. Yes, it's been 6 months and I only now ran out! A little goes a long way with this product. A pea-sized amount is all I need to wash away the day's makeup. It lathers beautifully and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and clean without feeling stripped. I highly recommend this cleanser!
This product was so fragranced it stung my eyes. It also left most of my makeup behind as well as a sticky film. Would not recommend.

this face wash cleanses and purifies and smells beyond phenomenal! It leaves the skin feel smooth, soft and radiant and it works great for prepping the skin before makeup and works EVEN BETTER at taking the day off! I swear by this cleanser.
Got this as a free sample and absolutely loved it. Been searching for a non drying creamy cleanser and this was it. Bought full size. Leaves my skin so soft.

I received a small sample that lasted me 14 face washes. It foams up so well when you add water that you don't need very much. I love a foamy cleanser, and the fact that this facewash literally makes my skin squeek. It also leaves a shine and removes all my makeup.. I have no idea why you wouldn't want a face wash that truly cleanses. I purchased this and its a huge bottle, so for the price it will definitely last!

I received this item for free from TopBox Circle for my honest opinion in review. I was SO excited to be chosen for this mission. This product certainly is very high quality. The compact is very sturdy. The product worked perfect with my skintone. I'm very impressed. I will be continuing to buy this compact.

If you have dry skin I would steer clear I find it to be a very drying cleanser and leaves you're skin with an also squeaky clean feeling which personally I don't love but that might be perfect for someone.

avis.titre: Only face wash I've used since November
avis.texte: - Favorite face wash! - non-stripping - the only face wash that doesnt make my skin feel tight - literally dont need much! Foam up just the smallest amount in your hands, then wash your face
This cleans my face so well, and a little bit does go a long way.. its foamy and feels soft and luxurious. I need the big bottle!

This cleanser is perfect to use after removing your makeup and throughly cleansing your skin. This doesn't feel too rough and stripping on your face, I always feel like my skin is throughly cleansed but not too dry. I love the scent and texture of this cleanser and I'm impressed with the new skincare products that Mac has been producing lately! I love the Hyper Real line!
Great cleanser. My face feels really clean after using, but it's not harsh on my skin. It smells lovely too. I highly recommend MAC's skincare line. I will definitely buy again.

avis.titre: I won't go without this stuff!
avis.texte: I've been an avid mac user for as long as I've been wearing makeup, it had no idea they had a cleanser. When I saw it I immediately purchased. This stuff is absolutely amazing. Its creamy on your skin, deep cleanses, gets all the makeup off, doesn't leave me dry, and smells AMAZING!!

This stuff is INCREDIBLE! It's so creamy and feels so nice on the skin..It has a very light, but beautiful scent that I love (I wish there was a body cream in this scent) I have very sensitive skin, but it doesn't break me out at all..I use this cleaner as step one, then I spray my face with Fix Plus Magic Radiance, then I apply the face serum (I never tried the under eye serum) Honestly, I use the face serum all over my face and also under eye, then I apply the balm afterwards..This routine has become a game changer for me..My skin has never looked better! I was hoping not to love this routine because of the cost of using so many products, but I must say, it's worth every penny and a little goes a long way with all of these skincare products, so it's definitely worth it..The craziest thing I've experienced with this product (and I swear, this isn't sponsored at all..lol) I had a very small line by my mouth that was driving me crazy..I even tried filler to get rid of it and it still showed..After my Mac skincare routine, the line is completely gone! I was truly amazed..I am not sure if it's the cleanser, the fix plus, the serum or the balm that got rid of it, but I couldn't be happier about that! If you are on the fence about purchasing Mac's skincare, just do it! I promise you'll thank me later! Thank you so much Mac!
It's very foamy. You don't need to much . It's smells great and feels very clean after.

I have been using this cleanser for a couple of months now and absolutely love it. It feels very luxurious and does an excellent job removing any makeup. My face feels really clean after using this product.

This MAC cleanser definitely did the job. It didn't feel like it stripped my skin at all. It made my face feel super clean from any dirt, oil or imperfections left on my face. It also made my face feel super hydrated, like some cleansers make your face feel dry afterwards but not this, it made my face feel so moisturizered, and hydrating. I definitely would recommend this cleanser to all my family and friends. I really enjoyed using this cleanser.

avis.titre: In love for the Hyper Real Cream-to-Foam Cleanser
avis.texte: In my opinion I really liked the Hyper Real Cream-to-Foam Cleanser for my skin. I would say that it's a perfect foam to prep your skin for makeup. It smells and feels luxurious and moisturizing but I can't tell if helps with acne and any skin problems. Something that I liked it's the quantity you can use to do the foam. A really small piece of the product makes a lot of foam. The felling that gives to your skin it's really good. I feel amazing with the cleanser. I would recommend to my friends.
Silky smooth, super hydrating, and deep cleansing. The best part is that a little goes a long way - a pea-sized amount foams up to enough to generously cover my face, neck, and décolleté.

avis.titre: It is nice, but not for the price point
avis.texte: I do like it. it is lightly scented so buyer beware. it's a lush foam. a little goes a long way. However for what it does (which is just clean)...its a bit overpriced. and I will not repurchase for that reason. it doesn't do anything extraordinary.

I've tried many cleansers and this wins hands down. Just a small pea-sized amount takes off all my makeup including mascara and eyeliner. Lasts for months. Leaves my dry skin smooth, not dry and ready for moisturizer.
Worked great for a crisp foundation base, but not great for already dry skin like myself.

avis.titre: Love the formula, hate the scent
avis.texte: To start with a positive, I really enjoyed the luxurious cream to foam consistency of this cleanser. The cream is thick, the foam is stick, but still rinses easily. It can remove even waterproof make-up; I would still double cleanse, but it does a great job from the first try. It leaves my skin a little bit dry (I need to follow-up with moisturizer), but not tight. The problem is that the Hyper Real entire range of products has a terrible strong scent that lingers. I assumed that at least for the cleanser it will go away fast, not be as unbearable as the cream. But no, the scent ruins the entire experience.

This face wash is decadent and super soft. It makes your skin feel very fresh and clean without a stripped feeling. I am excited to add this to my nightly routine! You will love how petal soft your face will feel when you go to sleep at night!

I got this as a sample when buying something from MAC. I was hestiant to try it because I have sensitive skin/rosacea and generally have a bad reaction to products. I decided to be brave and give it a try. Boy am I happy I did. My skin looks amazing. The redness seems to have disipated and my skin looks healthier and nourished. Highly recommend to anyone with sensitive skin.

GREAT FOR EVERYDAY USAGE. I HAVE NORMAL SKIN, SO IT DOESN'T DRY OUT MY SKIN. MY SKIN FEELS REFRESHED AND RENEWED AFTER USING. IT LATHERS WELL, SOMEWHAT HYDRATES AND LEAVES MY SKIN FEELING CLEAN AND SOFT.
I'm really impressed by this cleanser. You only need a pea sized amount for this to foam into a thick and smooth lather. It smells luxurious and leaves your face feeling very clean. Love it!

This cleanser really deep cleansing and takes away all oil, dirt, makeup, pollutants off your skin. This cleanser is no joke. It's excellent for oily greasy skin, but I would be a little nervous to recommend to someone with dry skin. I love this cleanser

I recently purchase this to prep my skin before makeup but ended up using it as a everyday cleanser and it really got my skin together because for some reason I started to develop enlarged pores and it shrunk them

this feels so luxurious and creamy when you apply and work into a foam/cream. i seriously love this and your skin feels so smooth and soft after. rinses cleanly. i'm buying one for my mom. ive never had so much fun using a cleanser before

Very gentle on skin. With a light delightful fragrance. After each use, your skin would feel very moisturized, Very little product goes a long way. Clean to foam cleanser leaving skin with a healthy looking glow.

Normally i love MAC products, but this cleanser is HORRIBLE. The worst I've ever used. It does not remove makeup but somehow still leaves my skin feeling SUPER stripped. If you use even just a LITTLE too much the chemical vapors from the cleanser burn my eyes. My skin and eyes are not sensitive and I have no allergies to products.

I'm so glad I pick this up when it was on sale for 40%, because it is by far the best product I purchased. First time using the cream to foam wash and I was not disappointed. A little goes a long way, and it lathers so much. I was worried the size of the bottle was too small, but I understand now and appreciate the size. I feel like this gets all of my makeup off and my face feels so clean and soft. Definitely going to keep this in my routine, and this skincare line is amazing. My skin is thriving so much, and I like to think it's because I truly invested in products that I have been using for quite some time and are so great for the skin in the long run!

avis.titre: Love it!  With one tiny change …
avis.texte: One of the best cleansers ever, especially as the second step in a double cleanse when you use the Cleansing Oil as the first. My skin feels fresh, hydrated, bouncy. My one tiny issue - I wish it was a flip top instead of a screw top cap. Trying to uncap it with wet hands is a bit of a mess. Still, that's a minor issue and more of a preference. I have purchased this more and once and will keep it up!
This cleanser was perfect for my vacation in a tropical environment last month. It kept my face moisturize while removing all the grease from this hot weather. I would buy it again that's for sure

avis.titre: Hyper Real Fresh Canvas Cream-To-Foam Cleanser
avis.texte: It's a good size for being a cleanser. Left my skin feeling clean. When I first tried it, thought there was a lot of fragrance in the product. The fragrance isn't overpowering, I just wasn't expecting it. So if you're sensitive or allergic to fragrance, I wouldn't recommend it. However, if you don't mind about the fragrance and not allergic, I would recommend. Definitely would get again.

I've been using the MAC Hyper Real Fresh Canvas Cream-To-Foam Cleanser for a few weeks now, and it has become a staple in my skincare routine. Here's my detailed review of this product: Packaging: The packaging is sleek and practical, typical of MAC's aesthetic. The tube is easy to handle and dispenses the right amount of product, ensuring no wastage. Texture and Application: The cleanser starts as a rich cream that feels luxurious when applied to the skin. As you massage it in, it transforms into a gentle foam that effectively cleanses without stripping the skin of its natural oils. The transition from cream to foam is smooth, and it feels incredibly satisfying during application. Performance: One of the standout features of this cleanser is its ability to thoroughly remove makeup and impurities. It leaves my skin feeling clean, refreshed, and incredibly soft. Despite its deep cleansing properties, it is gentle enough for daily use and doesn't cause any irritation or dryness, which is a big plus for my sensitive skin. Ingredients: MAC has crafted this cleanser with a blend of skin-loving ingredients that not only cleanse but also nourish the skin. I appreciate the inclusion of hydrating elements that help maintain my skin's moisture balance, leaving it looking healthy and radiant. Scent: The cleanser has a light, pleasant fragrance that is not overpowering. It adds a nice touch to the cleansing experience without being too strong for those with sensitivity to scents. Value f

This smells like Ivory Soap and straps my face just like it. This left me with that unpleasant squeaky clean face. I'm super dry and dehydrated so I have no oils to spare. Save your face and skip this
Overall I loved this product I was able to see fast results in the moth using it I was acne free and no discoloration or discomfort anymore.
Incredibly hydrating cleanser. A little goes a long way. Nice and thick and creamy cleanser.

Reminds me of an old school classic; cream to foam cleanser except this has newer science. Read the instructions. Keep away from your eyes. This isn't to remove makeup. You only need a tiny tiny amount. Like half a pea size, otherwise you risk cleaning your skin too deeply. This bottle should last you a very long time. I have oily skin and i use this cleanser maybe every other day. This deeply cleans your face. Use a toner/essence afterwards like fix+ magic radiance then follow up with serumizer and the balm. My skin has never been so good. Makes me not miss my lightful c softening lotion as much anymore. Highly recommend the hyper real collection as a whole cleansing routine.
Do not like the MAC facial cleanser. Leaves a sticky feeling on my face.
I use this face wash day and night. The foam for lather is amazing. The scent is pefectly clean. I have the full line of MAC cleanser products.

THE PRODUCT IS AMAZING AS AN EVERYDAY CLEANSER OR IN A TWO STEP CLEANSING PROCESS TO REMOVE MAKEUP. IT REMOVES ALL THE LAYERS SO WELL AND LATHERS WELL OVER THE SKIN. IT CAN LEAVE DRYER SKIN FEELING STRIPPED HOWEVER IT IS NOT HARSH.

avis.titre: Doesn't break out my skin , I love using this
avis.texte: This is by far the best product ever from Mac that I used for my face

I wear makeup every day & when I am ready to wash it off at the end of the day, I put some of this in my hands, lather it up and rub it on my face. After rinsing when I apply toner with a cotton pad I see no makeup left behind 😊 I feel squeaky clean
This cleanser is a good moisturizing cleanser. My skin felt hydrated after using it on my skin unlike other cleanser that strip your face and leave it feeling dry.
Yes I love the Mac Foam Cleanser it left my face feeling Smooth and Clean it also lighten it up my dark spots

This cleanser is a good moisturizing cleanser. My skin felt hydrated after using it on my skin unlike other cleanser that strip your face and leave it feeling dry. I do not think this would be an everyday cleanser for someone who is struggling with acne or wants to reduce breakouts. I think this would be a good cleanser to start off with to remove makeup or a winter morning cleanser.

avis.titre: It's too scented for a face wash
avis.texte: This facial cleanser has way too much fragrance, it literally smells like it could be a scented body wash. I would not recommend getting this unless you want pimples.
I absolutely love how soft and luxurious this wash leaves my face. It lathers up nicely and a little goes a long way without leaving your skin feeling stripped or dry!
I like it it's nice and gentle and smells really nice it's not a strong scent either which I like way more

This cleanser felt soooo luxurious and creamy on my face I've never felt anything like it!! It has the nicest scent of peony in it which is actually my favorite, but it's not too strong. Also, a little goes a long way! It lathers up so nicely, i love it for everyday!

The reason I've titled this review 'to each their own' is because it truly depends what your preferences are.. if you have acne prone skin and you are looking for non-acnegenic then skip this (Myristic Acid, Lauric acid, Algae Extract) If fragrances irritate you .. be weary . (ALTHOUGH IT SMELLS AMAZING) But is it a good cleanser? ABSOLUTELY , it makes you feel like you have a blank canvas and like it has done its job to clean and cleanse. It has other ingredients that are good, that do promote repairing of the barrier and even skin tone over time. So for the right candidate; oily skin, combo skin.. those in the market for something new …. DONT HESITATE!
This has so far been really good for my face. It goes a good job removing any excess make up and it's not rough on my skin.

I wasn't a fan of the scent at first, it smells like a body wash for a perfume but I got used to it the more I used it. A pearl size is truly what you need, it foams up well. I have sensitive skin and my skin isn't feel dry (I have combination skin).
Great cream that leaves you feeling moisturized. I normally use the Shiseido extra foam cleanser and it leaves left my skin feeling dry. This product left it feeling actually moisturized.
Honestly this is the best product I have ever tried on my face, I'm acne prone and this is about the only cleanser that hasn't broken me out! And it smells so good!
Not much of a difference of other face washed. Leave face soft but nothing extraordinary.
This cleanser is definitely excellent, perfect for cleansing your face after removing your makeup and continuing with your skincare routine
Leaves my skin glowing! I adore the scent, it's very clean and fresh feeling, and it leaves my skin ultra hydrated! Definitely recommend it!

I love Mac, so I am very disappointed in this cleanser. It is not at all effective at removing makeup and still leaves residue when toning after cleansing when no makeup has been worn. Using a powered face washing tool didn't even help. It also claims to be hydrating but it is not. My face is ashy dry after using this. It is in line with most foaming cleansers I've tried, but there are others that are NOT this drying and are effective. It's not necessarily smoothing either, as when my face gets dry it tends to get rougher and breaks out a little in those small bumps. It obviously will get rid of excess oil, but any moisture gets sucked out as well. The best parts of this cleanser are the very neutral, just smells like the bottle, scent for those with sensitivities, and the foam is rich and spreads easily so too much product is not being consumed at once. Unfortunately, I do not like this cleanser and my face has noticeably dulled using it.

avis.titre: Best cleanser you need to try!!!
avis.texte: I have been using this for several weeks now and I can not be happier. This is a very gentle but effective face wash. It is mild enough for my sensitive skin but powerful enough to get my makeup off! The bottle is a great size!
Excellent product brand quality value ingredients enchanted with this thanks for give me the opportunity to try never try something like quality of this one like it so much works perfectly

I tried this product out for about two weeks prior to writing this review, with that being said let's get into it. The product its self feels very luxurious. I really enjoyed the consistency of the cleanser its quite thick and creamy and it stays that way even after adding water. The foaming quality isn't your typical sudsy type of foam it's more of a creamy foam, if that makes sense ( photos below). A little does goes a long way with this product which I appreciated because Mac products aren't always the most affordable. The cleanser did a good job at removing and cleansing my make up (including mascara). However, I did notice that it leaves your face feeling "squeaky clean" after rising off the product, which isn't a feeling I overly enjoy experiencing on my face because it also feels a bit drying on the skin. Nevertheless, the less my skin did feel a little soft immediately after cleaning. This cleaner doesn't have any AHA's or BHA's, so If you're looking for a product that is going to help get rid of acne then this most likely isn't the cleanser for you. Ultimately, while this cleansers is nice it's not something I would RAVE about. I feel like there are other cleansers out there that are great cleansers and also do a fantastic job at removing makeup and cleaning the skin but at a much more affordable price. If you have the money, and want to experience this creamy lux consistency then definitely give it try.

Don't get me wrong the scent is beautiful! Something I would even wear as a perfume. It's just that much that is in the product. It's very silky and lathers well, but I just cannot get past the fragrance and how dry I feel after. Leaves you very clean but even I don't have sensitive skin and I had some signs of breaks out. I used consistently for over a week to confirm this.

avis.titre: It's feels nice on the skin
avis.texte: The cleanser itself feels really nice on the skin but for some reason for me personally it seemed have clogged my pores. I have very sensitive skin so maybe that's why it didn't really work out for me but it doesn't foam up very nicely. I would use it but I have other cleansers that seems to work better for my skin type. Overall I do recommend if you have normal type skin.

This is cream to foam cleanser I have ever used. It's gentle on my skin and leave my skin feeling soft and refreshed. This also the best smelling cleanser I've came by. 10/10 do recommend. I have been using it daily and have added it into my daily cleanse routine.

So I tested the cleanser on my hand and it made it way too dry. I automatically knew it wouldn't work for me so I gave it to my mother. My mother used it for a week but stopped cause it made her face peel. Personally, I would only recommend it for Oily skin or to use in your summertime routine.

My face has been loving this cream-to-foam cleanser. Morning routine or night routine, this cleanser fits right into my skincare regimen. I'm loving the three major key ingredients. Cationic hyaluronic acid boosts hydration in the skin while the Japanese Peony Extract helps increase radiance and even skin tone over time. Glycerin having antimicrobial properties helps repair the skin's natural barrier. Keeping your skin youthful and beautiful. I can feel the junk being stripped from my face without no harsh aftermath. My skin's moisture is thriving. I look forward to exploring more from this line. Although I was fortunate enough to receive this in exchange for a review, this review is filled with nothing but honesty. I'd give this product a 8/10! #freeproduct
Very foamy and a little goes along way. Great to take off makeup with

This cleanser was very hydrating and left my skin super soft and smooth to the touch. I would recommend this product to anyone with a oily to dry combination skin because it worked super well for me. overal i would give this cleanser a 5 stars

avis.titre: If you have dry skin/ eczema it's a no otherwise it's good
avis.texte: So it's not the worst cleanser ever but if you have extremely dry skin or eczema, it's not my first choice. You can possibly try to buffer it if you double cleansed with and oil or balm. Yes it takes of makeup on its own and foams and feels nice- that's the good part but the bad is if you used this as a regular cleanser on your light sunscreen, tinted moisturizer no makeup makeup days, it might be a little drying or tight feeling. There is also fragrance. It seems to be some kind formulated on the gentler side but it's still there if you are allergic. But for oily skin or in the summer when you're sweating and layering product and sunscreen, I'd say yes it's great !!

I love this. I have combination skin and it tends to be difficult to find a cleanser that's gentle enough but effective to deal with combination skin. This one was lovely. My skin didn't feel tight after washing. It removed mascara wonderfully. This is usually the worst part for me, so I was very pleased with how great it worked. Also, I enjoy the packaging. Easy to use with wet fingers. Good stuff

There aren't any added benefits or attributes that set this cleanser apart from other. The pros are that you don't need much to lather and cleanse your face. A little goes a long way so it may last 2-3 months if you use it right. Cleansing twice a day. It has a nice scent. Other than that I did not enjoy the cleanser all that much from the ones I've used in the past. Didn't feel or see any change in skin.
Great packaging. Had a face full of makeup used this cleaner and it got all of it off. Had my skin feeling so smooth and refreshing.
This cleanser smells so good, I loved that it didn't make my skin feel like squeaky clean but instead soft and moisturized and of course I am a fan of foam cleansers so the "lather" was a plus.

I received this product from BzzAgent but I am providing my honest review about this product. Fie fault use this stuff is amazing! For the light daily makeup you may wear out or just because, 10/10. But when you put makeup on that's meant to last svd not budge, I feel like you have to use more product than recommended and still need to use some wipes afterwards, 5/10. Overall gets the job done glad I was chosen to try! Would recommend for daily use (:
I was little skeptical because I have really sensitive skin how ever this cleanser was very gentle it smells so good and leaves my face soft and hydrated

avis.titre: My face never felt so clean!
avis.texte: When I first used this, it kinda blew my mind! I'm not sure if it's just because my face is oily naturally but it almost felt tingling applying this and afterwards my face felt so smooth. I have finished most of this bottle and will be buying more since my face has been super clear and has felt smoother than ever
i love this cleanser! my skin is really sensitive and dry, after using this product it didn't make it feel tight and dry! I felt moisturized and had a clean face
The packaging is yellow and minimal. I like foamy cleansers and this did the job without making my skin dry. Just keep in mind, it's fragrant, but I didn't mind.
This cleanser is so amazing it cleans my skin nicely without making it feel dry after or stripping my skin down, it has a scent but it's heavy fragranced it just smells clean.
What i love about this product is how smooth and refreshing my face is after using this product. I like to use it during my shower and it also smells great. Its a very light and clean scent.
I love how creamy and rich the cleanser feels and how hydrating it makes my skin feel.
Amazing cleanser cream for this winter season! My skin feels so much better after use it. I highly recommend this if you have combination or dry skin.

I love how you only need a pea size amount and it gets so foamy. That means the product will last even longer! I love the smell of it as well & it also leaves my skin feeling clean and soft afterwards!

avis.titre: Smells good, little goes a long way, but leaves an odd feel
avis.texte: I received this MAC hyper real fresh canvas cleanser free in exchange for my honest opinion. Things I like: this cleanser goes SO FAR. You really only need the smallest of pea-sized amounts to get a full face of the product. It's insane! This might be passed down to grandchildren lol It has a pleasant scent, and I'm usually scent-adverse! The packaging is sleek and minimalistic. Things I didn't like: how high up on the list of ingredients that fragrance is. How it made my face feel…it's a bit hard to describe but it left my face feeling a little too "squeaky" and filmy. Very odd. A little drying.
Left my skin feeling clean and didn't cause any irritation. I would definitely recommend

This MAC hyper real cream to foam cleanser worked excellent on my face. I absolutely love the smell of the cleanser and the scent lasts for a long while. I like how a little goes a long way. I haven't had any breakouts from using this cleanser. I love it!

This is a very nice face cleanser! It does have a strong fragrance to it, smells like florals, it's nice though! I have normal/oily skin and I really enjoyed using this, it did a good job of removing dirt and make up from my face but I was never able to get it to foam up, it would just stay creamy but I don't mind.

The smell is great. It smells like a luxury hotel item. It was gentle on my skin, it didn't foam the first couple uses but started after I used it a few times. It makes the skin feel squeaky clean. It didn't cause me any reactions and I can have super sensitive skin at times. Overall a good anytime clenser.

This cleanser is tough on makeup but gentle on the skin. It melts away all my makeup in one rinse & leave my skin feeling smooth & hydrated. The texture is silky smooth & I love that it's turns from cream to foam. The packaging is aesthetically pleasing too. Definitely recommend for an easier clean up skin care routine

I enjoy using the MAC cream to foam cleanser. I used it day and night for about 3 weeks. A small size goes a long way and leaves your face moisturized even after rinsing with water. Definitely would recommend.
I love using this cleanser before applying makeup it literally gives me a smooth fresh canvas to apply my products .

The cleanser feels so moisturizing when you first apply it, but once you rinse it off, it leaves the skin feeling dry. I would say it does a decent job at cleansing, but I have definitely used better cleansers that cleanse amazingly without stripping the skin. I will continue to use this product, but ultimately, it's not something that I would want to purchase once it runs out.

The Mac Cream to Foam cleanser is great! I've been using this cleanser consistently for the past month and I can attest to the fact that it's gentle yet effective. It has helped me finish removing any traces of makeup after a long day at work and leaves my skin feeling clean and hydrated.

I have really been enjoying this cleanser. It really does seem to cleanse the skin without stripping! It is the holy grail of cream cleansers and keeps my dry, aging skin hydrated. think I might finally be a product monogamist.

got this cleanser for free from MAC in exchange for writing a review, so this is my honest opinion on it. It works well in terms of clearing up my skin of any makeup, including the tiny pores between my eyebrows and on my nose that I can never really clean thoroughly. However, I think it does dry out my skin after I use it, but definitely not as much as when I use other cleansers. I feel like when I dries it out, it's as if it really is able to strip out all the product I used during the day, which isn't a bad thing in my opinion. I'd recommend this to others, especially to those with sensitive skin as well since I also have that and it didn't irritate me.

avis.titre: not worth it in my opinion
avis.texte: it's described as a cream to foam cleanser but there was literally NO foam . maybe i got a bad bottle but its a good cleanser . but its not what it's advertised .
Is nothing special. Just a good smelling face soap to clean your face

This is easily one of the best cleansers that I've ever used. My skin tends to be on the dryer side and a lot of face cleansers dry out my skin even more. I am constantly trying new cleansers, because the big name brands tend to leave me with small, dry patches on my face. I also tend to develop whiteheads easily, especially on my nose. I usually apply a toner after cleansing to help prevent them, but I decided to test this MAC cleanser by itself to see if it would have an effect. I have been using this cleanser for two weeks and I can already see some improvements with my skin. My face doesn't feel nearly as dry when I'm finished cleansing. As a result, I can apply a little less moisturizer. The cleanser itself almost feels like it's adding moisturizer. It is a nice cream that glides on to the skin. It removes any dirt and debris form my face without stripping away all of the natural oils. My face just feels fresher and smoother after using this cleanser. I do not wear makeup, so I do not have a lot of experience with MAC products, but after trying this cleanser, I am excited to explore more of their skincare line.
I received this product from BzzAgent for a honest review. The product was just ok. Felt like for Mac it could have been better in the quality.

Overall this could be a good product on non acne prone skin. Above that, my skin gets very sensitive when it comes to trying new products so I unfortunately did not have the best results. I hope someone else can enjoy this product as much as I wished to.

I am super in love with this product so i tried it without thinking something was gonna be different the first use but honestly saw the first thing i liked about Hypor Roal FRESH CANVAS CREAM-TO-FOAM CLEANSER after the first try. First i recommend to use this product after a long day full of heavy make up use it as your second cleanser because this will make sure the makeup remaining is actually out. The foaming feels so yummy in your skin when you apply it. The odors is not very strong. It has become a staple in my shower routine specially after a long day of work with heavy makeup. I order another one to have extra in my shower i really like how the skin is left so glowy and shiny after you get out the shower and you was all that gunk of your face. I truly recommend and i also already bought my second so im in love. Also this product i did not know mac had it until i got asked to try it and got to look more into this hyper real system and i am loving the direction mac is taking with this skin care product line.

I have been using this cleanser for a few weeks now and it has definitely became one of my fave cleansers. It doesn't have a bad or very strong scent and I like that it's light and creamy and gets foamy once you add water. It does a really good job at removing my makeup residue and doesn't leave my skin feeling oily or greasy, which is my favorite part, it actually leaves my skin feeling squeaky clean but not dried out.

This cleanser was pleasantly surprising. Was it life-changing? No. However, I think that this is a great cleanser to have in my rotation. I love that it truly is a cream to foam product, and that it was not a marketing gimmick. I did not like, however, that there was a slight fragrance. Sometimes my skin is a little sensitive to fragrances, so I like to avoid them when I first tried product if possible.

A little bit certainly goes a long way with this product. Unfortunately, I could tell there was fragrance the moment it touched my face. While washing, it started to burn a bit right before washing off. So ultimately, my face did not agree with this product, leaving it a little red afterwards.
I love the packaging this comes in. This smells real good and always leaves my face feeling fresh after cleaning my makeup! I love it!!

Great cleanser! Smells really good, but not too strong. Leaves the skin feeling clean, but not stripped. I've been able to incorporate it into my daily skincare routine with no hiccups- breakouts or negative interaction with other products. Removes my makeup well and works up to a very nice foam. Highly recommend!
This cream to foam cleanser is ok. Maybe for oily skin works better. I have dry skin and my face feels very dry after I apply this cleanser. I wouldnt recommend to dry skin people.
Hi, I'm barely start to build my skin care products and I'm honestly very pleased with this product.

I absolutely love my HyperReal Cream-to-Foam Cleanser. It does wonders for me. I am never looking back this is a new beginning for me and definitely a new and easy life with this product. I am already bragging about it on social media !
This cleanser is very gentle on the skin, it really doesn't have much of a smell. I like that it doesn't leave your skin feeling dry after you use it or like it's been stripped.

I've been using the MAC US Hyper Real Cream-to-Foam Cleanser for a few weeks not and I really love it so far. I feel the foamy really helps get rid of my make up and doesn't dry out my skin after I wash it.

I've always been a long time fan of Mac but I had never thought to use there skincare but I'm so glad I finally did because my acne prone skin has loved it. My face feels so clean without feeling dry and stripped.

avis.titre: Favorite cleanser in a long time!
avis.texte: I've been using this cleanser twice daily for the past three weeks. I wear heavy makeup almost daily and after removing the heavy pigments and going over my face with mc water, I use this cleanser. It does a great job bringing the life back to my skin, and my face never feels tight after use- more so bouncy and nourished, and my radiance has improving as well. It's very gentle, as my skin is extremely sensitive after heavy makeup, and feels really luxurious. A little goes a long way too when you lather it up, so I can see this container easily lasting me a month or more. Big fan of this and will be getting another!

The MAC hyper real cream to foam cleanser lathered really nicely. I loved that it didn't strip away my skin like my current face wash. My skin feels fresh after using it and not dried out. I use the cleanser in the morning before my skin care and makeup and have noticed my makeup going on even better. A little bit goes a long way.
